scripts.check-migrations-workflows: cd apps/workflow/server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.start-cmt: npm run check-migrations-workflows && npx nx run-many -t start-cmt -p cmt-frontend cmt-backend workflows-server
scripts.stop-cmt: echo 'stopping in case nx run-many didn't stop automatically' && npx nx run-many -t stop -p cmt-frontend cmt-backend workflows-server
